Juab County Justice Court House: Your Complete Guide

Essential Information

  • Address: 160 N Main St, Nephi, UT 84648
  • Phone: (435) 623-3440
  • Website: juabcounty.gov

Hours of Operation

Monday – Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM Closed on weekends

Overview of the Juab County Justice Court

The Juab County Justice Court House stands as a cornerstone of the legal system in Nephi, Utah. This guide provides essential information about the courthouse's services, procedures, and role in the community.

Services and Case Types

The courthouse handles various legal matters, including:

  • Civil disputes and small claims
  • Criminal cases
  • Traffic violations
  • Family court matters
  • Citation contests
  • Legal document filing

Court Procedures: What to Expect

When visiting the courthouse, here's what you should know:

Filing a Case

The court accepts both in-person and electronic filings for most cases. To file:

  1. Gather all necessary documentation
  2. Complete required forms (available at the courthouse or online)
  3. Pay applicable filing fees
  4. Submit your paperwork to the court clerk

Attending Court

  • Arrive at least 15 minutes before your scheduled time
  • Bring all relevant documents
  • Follow proper courtroom etiquette
  • Check in with court staff upon arrival

Modern Technology Integration

The courthouse has embraced digital solutions to improve accessibility:

  • Electronic filing systems
  • Virtual court appearances when applicable
  • Digital document management
  • Online payment options for fines and fees

Community Resources

The courthouse provides several community services:

  • Legal assistance programs
  • Public record access
  • Educational resources
  • Community outreach initiatives

Location and Accessibility

The courthouse is conveniently located in downtown Nephi:

  • Easy access from Main Street
  • Public parking available
  • ADA-compliant facilities
  • Close to public transportation

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I bring to court?

  • Government-issued photo ID
  • All relevant case documents
  • Any required payments
  • Supporting evidence for your case

How can I pay fines?

  • Online through the court website
  • In-person at the courthouse
  • By mail with certified funds
  • Phone payments for eligible cases

Do I need a lawyer?

While not always required, legal representation is recommended for complex cases. The court can provide information about legal aid resources if needed.

Can I contest a traffic ticket?

Yes, you can contest traffic citations by:

  1. Appearing in court on your scheduled date
  2. Filing a written response before the deadline
  3. Requesting a hearing with the court

Contact Information

For additional information or assistance:

  • Main Phone: (435) 623-3440
  • Email: Available through website contact form
  • Physical Address: 160 N Main St, Nephi, UT 84648
  • Website: Visit juabcounty.gov

Planning Your Visit

  • Check the court calendar for your hearing date
  • Arrive early to allow time for security screening
  • Bring all required documentation
  • Consider parking options in advance
  • Review courthouse rules and guidelines
